HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.title: The Paladin
HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.description: Sworn to a light that has not answered in a long time. Holds the line anyway.
HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.goldMonologue: Coin is just another thing to be responsible for.
HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.eventDeathPrevention: The Paladin plants their shield and refuses the ending.
HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.aromaPrinciple: Smells like cold iron and old incense.
HELLOSPIRE-PALADIN.cardsModifierDescript: The Paladin's deck is still borrowed steel. For now.
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.title: The Alchemist
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.description: Treats the Spire as a very large, very hostile experiment. Takes notes between fights.
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.goldMonologue: Reagents are not cheap, and neither is curiosity.
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.eventDeathPreventio: Something in the Alchemist's satchel fizzes, and the ending is postponed.
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.aromaPrinciple: Smells like scorched copper and something faintly medicinal.
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMIST.cardsModifierDescri: The Alchemist's deck is still borrowed apparatus. For now.
HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.title: The Gunslinger
HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.description: Arrived with six shots and no plan for the seventh. Fast, loud, and running out of road.
HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.goldMonologue: Gold buys powder. Powder buys another minute.
HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.eventDeathPreventi: The Gunslinger's hammer falls on an empty chamber, and somehow that is enough.
HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.aromaPrinciple: Smells like spent powder and road dust.
HELLOSPIRE-GUNSLINGER.cardsModifierDescr: The Gunslinger's deck is still borrowed iron. For now.
